recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only revisit if FHIR-I makes a new explicit R6 decision to narrow the subscription resource selector bindings; do not mechanically apply the older Jira word 'required' over the current applied issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-38800 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to stop binding Subscription.filterBy.resourceType and SubscriptionTopic.resourceTrigger.resource to all FHIR types and instead bind to resource-type values; the Jira resolution text says required binding to version-independent-resource-types, while the approving FHIR-I minutes recorded the accepted change as extensible binding to that value set.
initial_application: Commits 6dbe9eae994 and a8293dbc39 first moved the affected subscription bindings from fhir-types toward resource-types/all-resource-types. Commit e4294d8526f3 added fhir-old-types, version-independent-resource-types, and subscription-types, and switched Subscription.filterBy.resourceType to subscription-types while retaining extensible strength. Follow-up commits 9082a9058ae and 23bc6d67239 added the current-version all-resource-types additional UI binding and moved SubscriptionTopic resource selectors to the same subscription-types pattern.
additional_context: Current R6 source has renamed Subscription.filterBy.resourceType to Subscription.filterBy.resource and collapsed SubscriptionTopic.resourceTrigger.resource into SubscriptionTopic.trigger.resource, with fhir.ini aliases preserving the old paths. Later FHIR-46492 and FHIR-47365 subscription work broadened SubscriptionTopic guidance for event triggers, logical models, and non-FHIR definitions. FHIR-39024 and FHIR-40492 already have combined-branch reconciliation records and support the same value-set family rather than requiring a new FHIR-38800 source edit.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The latest combined branch already has Subscription.filterBy.resource and SubscriptionTopic.trigger resource selector bindings to ValueSet/subscription-types, whose composition includes ValueSet/version-independent-resource-types, plus all-resource-types additional UI bindings. Narrowing those bindings to required version-independent-resource-types would conflict with the work-group minutes and later subscription decisions.
